name: Yumegasaki Maaya
source:
Resident of room 201. She is a homely, plain, and quiet succubus. She's more hooked on manga, anime, and games than the opposite sex, and has now become a full-fledged shut-in.

Due to poor lifestyle habits, her stomach and hips have gotten flabby, but she doesn't care.
Once she takes a liking to something, she demands it until satisfied, and has a history of losing her virginity through frenzied self-pleasure.

She's recently developed a fascination with kinky play after overindulging in erotic manga and games... but she's still a virgin.

[From [url=http://clockup.net/scap/]official site[/url]]
